title: Electron Application Packaging Target
description: Electron application packaging target options for Build Facade

name.description: The name of the electron application.
name.x-prompt: What's the name the of electron (backend) application you would like to package?

frontendProject.description: Frontend project that needs to access this application.
frontendProject.x-prompt: What's the name the frontend application you would like to package?

extraProjects.description: Extra projects to include in the application package.

sourcePath.description: Directory, relative to the workspace root, that contains the build outputs of `frontendProject` and `extraProjects` (as `<sourcePath>/<project>`). Relative `from` paths of `files` entries are resolved against it as well. The electron application itself is taken from the `outputPath` of its `nx-electron:build` target, or from `<sourcePath>/<name>` if it has none.

outputPath.description: Directory, relative to the workspace root, that electron-builder writes to. With `prepackageOnly`, `executables` in the path is replaced by `packages`.

failOnMissingFiles.description: Fail the packaging when the source ('from') of a configured copy step ('files', 'extraResources', 'extraFiles', 'frontendProject', 'extraProjects') does not exist. Set to false to only log a warning and let electron-builder silently skip the entry.
